title: QA/QC Validation Workflow
trigger: Milestone submission or model state approval event

steps.action: Run the required standards checks or applicable ruleset.
Document findings and the remediation list.
Record the approve or reject decision for the tested model state together with supporting evidence.

governance_notes: The source identifies future QA/QC Checklist and Approval Log assets.
Repository governance distinguishes technical QA evidence from broader contractual or client acceptance; this workflow does not override S5/S7 authority rules.

provenance.migration_note: Source workflow W7.2 migrated from the workflow catalogue. Future checklist and approval-log assets remain unresolved.
